title: Market Research
standfirst: The methods and analytics of understanding a market — survey design, sampling, segmentation, and insight.

resources.label: Course notes
resources.desc: Notes and study material for this course.

resources_note: An IITM email may be required for some of the resources above; any other access request will be strictly rejected.

description_paragraphs: This course provides a foundational understanding of research methodology and its application across business domains, with a focus on marketing research. It covers the role, scope, process, cost, and value of research, aligns techniques with business problems, and develops skills in data analysis and translating insights into actionable outcomes through hands-on projects.
faculty: Mr. Ashok Sankethi, CEO, Kaybase Research

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Introduction to market research; Industry overview; Research process; Sampling methods and sample size determination.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Basic statistics for market research; Key terms and concepts.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Questionnaire design; Survey structuring and best practices.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Qualitative research methods; Interviews and discussion guides; Data collection techniques.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Applied market research; Brand health assessment; Customer satisfaction measurement.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Advertising research; Ad pre-testing; Questionnaire design for campaigns.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Employee satisfaction studies; Concept testing methods.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Brand research applications; Corporate and celebrity brand evaluation.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Consumer profiling and segmentation; Consumer decision journey (CDJ).

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: CDJ case studies; Market intelligence sources (India context).

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: Data analysis in market research; Interpretation and reporting.
